verdict.rationale: Llama publishes its own license and per-family acceptable use policies. The license covers commercial entities, and the FAQ adds an attribution condition, so commercial terms and a prohibited-use policy are documented. The evidence does not show what the policy actually prohibits, says nothing about data handling, and does not show the terms are in plain language. The 700M MAU special-license clause is reported only by the community. Missing for 10: quoted prohibited-use content, any data-handling commitments, evidence of plain-language clarity, first-party documentation of the MAU threshold.

support.subject: As a founder, the usage policy is clear about what I may build — prohibited uses, commercial terms, and data-handling commitments in plain language
